# Libreclipart hobby, occupation, and family artwork

This focused collection adds two new items that fill less-covered practical searches: an appliance repair worker and construction safety signage. Stable `libreclipart-{source ID}-v1` references are available through the existing Studio library.

## Rights and provenance

- Source: [Libreclipart.org](https://libreclipart.org/en/). `life-events-assets.json` records each exact item page and SVG download, source tags, page title/description and publication date.
- License: [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), corroborated by the [site's license statement](https://libreclipart.org/en/licenses), each item page and the original SVG rights metadata. Commercial end-product use, modification, and redistribution are allowed without required attribution.
- `life-events-SOURCE-MANIFEST.json` records the original SVG rights and creator metadata, item and license evidence URLs, and original/normalized SHA-256 hashes. The unmodified originals remain in `life-events-source/`. `node scripts/ingest-libreclipart-life-events.mjs` validates rights, asset URLs, SVG safety and rendering before generating the Studio records.
- Eleven neighboring candidates were reviewed. The baby dinosaur graphic was refused because the original SVG says “Free OSI License,” which conflicts with the item's CC0 page statement. Eight of the other accepted images were already present in earlier Libreclipart packs, so they were not registered again.

The source labels Libreclipart.org as publisher. Individual artist identities are not inferred; SVG creator fields are kept verbatim. Studio intent tags are curated for the visible subjects and practical designs.
